svg.aria-label: What each failure does. Conflict: names the files, aborts the rebase, leaves the branch as before. Big file: names the file and size, even when a later commit deletes it. Test failure: lists up to five failing tests. Push failure: shows the e2e line and the last git message. Nothing to land: stops.

g.text: Conflict: names the files, aborts the rebase, branch is as it was
File over 5 MB: names file and size, even if a later commit deletes it
Test failure: lists up to five failing tests, nothing pushed
Push failure: prints the e2e line and the last git message; main may have moved, run again
Uncommitted edits to tracked files stop it before the rebase starts.
